tagline: Licensed tree service in Miami-Dade County — removal, trimming and stump grinding

why_choose_us.title: Rafael quotes every job himself
why_choose_us.description: The owner walks your property, prices the work and gives you the scope in writing — usually the same day you call. You are not handed to a salesman on commission.

why_choose_us.title: 5.0 stars across 200+ Google reviews
why_choose_us.description: Licensed and insured in Miami-Dade since 2019, with a review record customers keep describing in the same three words: on time, professional, spotless.

why_choose_us.title: We handle the county permits
why_choose_us.description: Miami-Dade requires permits for protected and heritage species, and Coral Gables and Pinecrest run their own on top. We identify what applies and coordinate it before anything is cut.

why_choose_us.title: Full cleanup on every single job
why_choose_us.description: Our own chipper and chip truck go to every job, so the debris leaves with us the same day instead of sitting at your kerb waiting on a second trip.

gallery.title: Storm cleanup, chipped and hauled the same day
gallery.alt: Crew feeding storm-felled branches into a chipper on a residential street while a bucket lift works the damaged tree behind
gallery.description: Chipping as we cut is what keeps a tree job to one day instead of leaving a pile at the kerb.

gallery.title: Tight-access removal by tracked lift
gallery.alt: Compact tracked spider lift set up in a narrow side yard beside a two-storey house to reach a large tree
gallery.description: The tracked lift fits through a side gate and spreads its weight across the turf, so we reach back-garden trees without a truck on the lawn.

gallery.title: Ficus brought back to a maintainable canopy
gallery.alt: Before and after of a large ficus, overgrown and shapeless on the left, reduced to a defined rounded canopy on the right
gallery.description: A crown reduction rather than a topping — cut back to laterals so the tree keeps its structure and holds the shape for years.

gallery.title: Large removal, sectioned down
gallery.alt: Crew member beside a large tree cut down to two trunk sections, surrounded by the sectioned canopy laid out on the lawn
gallery.description: Taken down in pieces and lowered rather than felled, so nothing swung into the house or the neighbouring property.

gallery.title: Palm cluster cleared of dead fronds
gallery.alt: Before and after of a cluster of palms, heavy with dead fronds on the left and cleanly trimmed on the right with a lift alongside
gallery.description: Dead fronds and seed pods removed without cutting into the live crowns — the opposite of a hurricane cut.

gallery.title: Date palm pruned to a clean crown
gallery.alt: Before and after of a date palm, heavy with dead fronds on the left and pruned back to a clean crown on the right
gallery.description: Correct palm work takes the dead material and leaves the live crown that feeds the tree and buffers wind.

gallery.title: Coconut palm removal
gallery.alt: Before and after of a coconut palm beside a house, standing on the left and fully removed with the debris stacked on the right
gallery.description: Removed in sections over a patio and pool enclosure, with the fronds and nuts cleared before we left.

gallery.title: Overgrowth cleared back to open ground
gallery.alt: Before and after of an overgrown corner of a garden, dense vegetation on the left and cleared open ground on the right
gallery.description: Roots taken out rather than cut to the ground, which is the difference between clearing it and clearing it again next season.

gallery.title: Mature live oak, thinned and cleared
gallery.alt: Mature live oak with a wide spreading canopy over a suburban street, with a bucket truck parked alongside
gallery.description: Selective thinning keeps the size and the shade while letting wind pass through instead of pushing against the canopy.

gallery.title: Palm work from the ground up
gallery.alt: Tropical South crew member in a branded blue shirt using an extension pole saw on a palm beside a trimmed hedge
gallery.description: Not every job needs a lift — a lot of routine palm maintenance is pole work, done properly.

services_section.subtitle: Twenty services from one licensed and insured crew — removal, trimming, stump grinding, 24/7 storm response, land clearing and ISA-certified arborist reports.

closing_cta.headline: Get a free quote from the owner, usually the same day
closing_cta.body: Rafael walks the property, prices the work and puts the scope in writing — at no charge. Licensed and insured in Miami-Dade since 2019, 5.0 stars across 200+ Google reviews, and full cleanup included on every job.
